title: RAGE
meta: Rubius Haggard • Level 3 Berserker Ability • 1 Action • 1/Turn
body: Roll a Fury Die (1d4) and set it aside. Add it to every STR attack you make. You can have a maximum of KEY Fury Dice; they are lost when your Rage ends.

title: THAT ALL YOU GOT?!
meta: Rubius Haggard • Level 3 Berserker Reaction • When Attacked • Spend Fury
body: When you are attacked, you may expend 1 or more Fury Dice to reduce the damage taken by STR + DEX for each die spent.

title: BLOODLUST
meta: Rubius Haggard • Level 3 Berserker Ability • On Your Turn • Spend Fury
body: Expend 1 or more Fury Dice on your turn. Move DEX spaces per die spent for free.

title: MOUNTAINOUS TENACITY
meta: Rubius Haggard • Level 3 Mountainheart Ability • Spend Hit Dice
body: Whenever you expend Hit Dice to recover HP, for every 10 HP you would recover, you may heal 1 Wound instead.

title: ONE WITH THE ANCIENTS
meta: Rubius Haggard • Level 3 Berserker Ability • 1/Safe Rest
body: When faced with a decision about which direction or course of action to take, call upon your ancestors to guide you toward the most dangerous or challenging path.

title: CHEAT
meta: Whisper • Level 3 Cheat Ability • Passive / 1/Round / 1/Safe Rest
body: Once per round, Move or Hide for free. Once per Safe Rest, change any skill check to 10 + INT. If Initiative is below 10, change it to 10. Gain advantage at games, competitions, or wagers, if you are not caught.

title: VICIOUS OPPORTUNIST
meta: Whisper • Level 3 Cheat Ability • 1/Turn
body: When you hit a Distracted target with a melee attack, you may change the Primary Die roll to any result you like. Changing it to the maximum value counts as a critical hit.

title: SNEAK ATTACK
meta: Whisper • Level 3 Cheat Ability • When You Crit • 1/Turn
body: When you critically hit, deal +1d8 damage. This damage is added to the attack and is not a separate attack.

title: RADIANT JUDGMENT
meta: Rowan Hearthboro • Level 3 Oathsworn Ability
body: Whenever an enemy attacks you, if you have no Judgment Dice, roll 2d8. On your next melee attack this encounter, deal that much additional radiant damage if you hit. The dice are expended whether you hit or miss.

title: LAY ON HANDS
meta: Rowan Hearthboro • Level 3 Oathsworn Ability • 1 Action • Touch
body: Your healing pool has a maximum of 5 x level (15 HP) and recharges on a Safe Rest. Touch a target and spend any amount from the pool to restore that much HP.

title: ZEALOT
meta: Rowan Hearthboro • Level 3 Oathsworn Ability • Melee Attack
body: When you attack with a melee weapon, spend mana up to your highest unlocked spell tier. For each mana, choose: Condemning Strike - deal +5 radiant damage; or Blessed Aim - decrease the target's Armor by 1 step for this attack.

title: AURA OF REFUGE
meta: Rowan Hearthboro • Level 3 Oath of Refuge Ability • Reach 4
body: Your shields gain +WIL Armor and count as your spellcasting focus. You can Interpose for an ally anywhere within your Reach 4 aura.

title: IRON DEFENSE
meta: Lil Chang • Level 3 Zephyr Ability • While Unarmored
body: Your Armor equals DEX + STR as long as you are unarmored.

title: SWIFT FISTS
meta: Lil Chang • Level 3 Zephyr Ability • Unarmed Strikes
body: Your unarmed strikes are not subject to disadvantage imposed by Rushed Attacks, and their damage is 1d4 + STR.

title: BURST OF SPEED
meta: Lil Chang • Level 3 Zephyr Ability • At Initiative • 1/Turn
body: At Initiative, gain DEX Bursts for this encounter. Spend 1 for a free maneuver: Slipstream - Defend and the attack misses; Whirling Defense - Defend and apply Armor to every attack this round; Swiftstrike - attack without Rushed disadvantage; Windstep - Move ignoring difficult terrain.

title: KINETIC MOMENTUM
meta: Lil Chang • Level 3 Zephyr Ability
body: Whenever you gain a Wound, gain 1 Burst of Speed.

title: BRING THE PAIN
meta: Lil Chang • Level 3 Way of Pain Ability
body: You may turn any melee attack against you into a critical hit. Whenever you are critically hit, halve the damage and deal the amount you took back to the attacker, ignoring Armor. You may suffer 1 Wound to double the reflected damage.

title: PILFERED POWER
meta: Alder • Level 3 Shadowmancer Ability
body: Steal power from your Patron to cast tiered spells at the highest tier unlocked. You may do this DEX times before your Patron notices. Each excess use costs half your maximum HP. The limit resets when you commune during a Safe Rest.

title: MASTER OF NIGHTFROST
meta: Alder • Level 3 Abyssal Depths Ability
body: Learn Ice spells and breathe underwater. Shadow Blast and nightfrost minions may deal cold or necrotic damage. Whenever they would critically hit, gain INT + level temporary HP.

title: MASTER OF DARKNESS
meta: Alder • Level 3 Shadowmancer Ability
body: Your Patron grants you knowledge of Necrotic cantrips and tier 1 Necrotic spells.

title: LOW BLOW
meta: Skritch • L3 Scoundrel Ability • Sneak Attack • Spend 2 Actions
body: When you Sneak Attack, you may spend 2 additional actions. The target makes a STR save, DC 10 + INT (12). Failure: Incapacitated next turn. Save or fail: Taunted by you until you drop to 0 HP.

title: CHEAT
meta: Skritch • Level 3 Cheat Ability • Passive / 1/Round / 1/Safe Rest
body: Once per round, Move or Hide for free. Once per Safe Rest, change any skill check to 10 + INT (12). If Initiative is below 10, change it to 10. Gain advantage at games, competitions, or wagers, if you are not caught.

title: WILY
meta: Skritch • Kobold Ancestry Ability • 1/Encounter
body: Force an enemy to reroll a non-critical attack against you once per encounter. Gain +3 Influence with friendly characters and advantage on dragon-related checks. You know Draconic if your INT is not negative.

title: HUNTER'S MARK
meta: Da Long • Level 3 Hunter Ability • 1 Action • Lasts 1 Day
body: Mark a creature you can see as your quarry for 1 day, or until you mark another creature. It cannot be hidden from you. Before each attack against it, choose advantage or +3 damage.

title: THRILL OF THE HUNT
meta: Da Long • Level 3 Hunter Ability
body: Gain 1 Thrill charge when your quarry dies, you hit it in melee, or you critically hit it at range. Abilities that spend Thrill cannot generate it. Unspent charges are lost when combat ends.

title: GO FOR THE THROAT!
meta: Da Long • L3 Beastmaster • 1/Encounter • 2 Thrill + 2 Actions
body: Quickfeather attacks your quarry for 1d12 + 12 damage, ignoring Armor. If it dies, deal half as much damage to another creature within Reach 4.

title: ROLL & STRIKE
meta: Da Long • Level 3 Hunter Ability • 1 Action • Requires 0 Thrill
body: If you have no Thrill charges, move up to your Speed toward your quarry. If you end adjacent, make a melee attack against it for free.

title: ALPHA PROTECTOR
meta: Da Long • Level 3 Beastmaster Feature • Large Companion
body: Damage from the first attack against you each round is halved.

title: COORDINATED STRIKE!
meta: Feng Rui • Level 3 Commander Order • 1/Round • INT (2)/Safe Rest • Free Action
body: You and one ally within 6 spaces each immediately make a weapon attack or cast a cantrip for free.

title: REPOSITION!
meta: Feng Rui • Level 3 Commander Order • Action / Reaction on an Ally's Turn
body: Command one ally to move up to their Speed for free, or two allies to each move up to half their Speed for free.

title: SHIELD EXPERT
meta: Feng Rui • Level 3 Champion of the Bulwark Ability • 1/Round
body: Reduce damage from an attack by your shield's Armor value without Defending. When you do, deal that much damage to an enemy within Reach.

title: HOLD THE LINE!
meta: Feng Rui • L3 Commander Order • 1/Encounter • Reaction at Ally 0 HP
body: Command that ally to continue the fight. Set their HP to 3 × your level (9).

title: FIELD MEDIC
meta: Feng Rui • Level 3 Commander Ability
body: Roll 1 additional die for any health potion you administer. After you spend at least 10 minutes examining a creature's wounds, they add your Examination bonus to HP recovered from Hit Dice.

title: MERCIFUL HEALING
meta: Cai Lin • Level 3 Luminary of Mercy Ability
body: When an effect you cause heals a Dying creature, it heals twice as much. Once per round while you are Dying, your Lifebinding Spirit may act for free.

title: SWIFT FEET

meta: Lil Chang • Level 3 Zephyr Ability • 1/Day • 10-Minute Meditation
body: Project a visible, translucent version of yourself up to 30 feet away for up to 10 minutes. It passes through barriers and you see through its eyes, but it cannot interact physically with the environment.

title: RELENTLESS
meta: Lil Chang • Orc Ancestry Ability • 1/Safe Rest
body: When you would drop to 0 HP, set your HP to your level (3) instead. Gain +1 Might. You know Goblin, which you call Orcish, if your INT is not negative.

title: FEARLESS
meta: Lil Chang • Background Ability
body: You are immune to the Frightened condition. Gain +1 Initiative and -1 Armor.

title: MY FAVORED PET
meta: Alder • Lesser Shadow Invocation
body: One shadow minion can begrudgingly tolerate you outside combat. It can, very creepily, perform any menial task a below-average commoner could.

title: DANGER POLLEN / SPORES
meta: Alder • Shroomling Ancestry Ability
body: Whenever an enemy causes you 1 or more Wounds, excrete soporific spores: all adjacent enemies are Dazed. You know Elvish if your INT is not negative.

title: WILD ONE
meta: Alder • Background Ability
body: Wild creatures are less frightened of you and more willing to aid you. Gain +1 Nature Craft. During a Field Rest in the wild, roll your Hit Dice with advantage.

title: TALENTED RESEARCHER
meta: Umbrail • Level 3 Mage Ability
body: Gain advantage on Arcana or Lore checks when you have access to a large number of books and time to study them.

title: FORCE OF CHAOS
meta: Umbrail • Level 3 Invoker of Chaos Ability

title: HOLLOW BONES
